# Scif Low Vlt Windows

## Description
For exterior FixedWindows in the given spaces, replace their construction with the LVLT variant (appends LVLT to the current construction name).

## Modeler Description
For exterior FixedWindows in the given spaces, replace their construction with the LVLT variant (appends LVLT to the current construction name).

## Measure Type
ModelMeasure

## Taxonomy


## Arguments


### New space name
This name will be used as the name of the new space.
**Name:** space_name,
**Type:** String,
**Units:** ,
**Required:** true,
**Model Dependent:** false


### Suffix to append to construction name
The LVLT construction is found by <current name> + this suffix.
**Name:** lvlt_suffix,
**Type:** String,
**Units:** ,
**Required:** true,
**Model Dependent:** false
